name: Timberwell Berhad
overview: Timberwell Berhad 今年通过认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 额外 10.77% 股权，将后者持股比例提升至 78.09%，使其成为控股子公司；同时公司收到 Quattrini Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 提出的无条件强制全面收购要约。运营方面，原木月度产量有波动，橡胶产量自 4 月起恢复记录，但季度产量同比仍下降。
overview_en: Timberwell Berhad increased its equity interest in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. to 78.09% via subscription of an additional 10.77% stake, making it a majority-owned subsidiary; the company also received an unconditional mandatory take-over offer from Quattrini Holdings Sdn. Bhd. Operationally, monthly log production fluctuated and rubber production resumed recording from April, though quarterly production remained lower year-on-year.

segments.name: 林业
segments.note: 原木月度产量有波动，季度产量同比减少。
segments.note_en: Monthly log production fluctuated, with quarterly output lower year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026 年第三季度原木产量为 9,707.71 立方米，较上年同期减少 17.00%。
actions.text_en: Log production for Q3 2026 was 9,707.71 cubic metres, down 17.00% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026 年第二季度原木产量为 6,654.46 立方米，较上年同期减少 51.00%。
actions.text_en: Log production for Q2 2026 was 6,654.46 cubic metres, down 51.00% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026 年第一季度原木产量为 3,178.48 立方米，上年同期为 331.38 立方米。
actions.text_en: Log production for Q1 2026 was 3,178.48 cubic metres, compared with 331.38 cubic metres a year earlier.

segments.name: 种植园
segments.note: 橡胶产量自 2026 年 4 月起恢复记录，季度产量有波动。
segments.note_en: Rubber production resumed recording from April 2026, with quarterly output fluctuating.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026 年第三季度橡胶产量为 11,180 公斤，上一季度为 47,000 公斤。
actions.text_en: Rubber production for Q3 2026 was 11,180 kg, compared with 47,000 kg in the preceding quarter.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 2026 年第二季度橡胶产量为 47,000 公斤，上年同期为零。
actions.text_en: Rubber production for Q2 2026 was 47,000 kg, compared with nil a year earlier.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司层面发生股权认购和强制全面收购要约等事项。
segments.note_en: Company-level events include an equity subscription and a mandatory take-over offer.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 公司以每股 RM1.00 认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 额外 14,750,000 股普通股（10.77% 股权），认购后持股比例增至 78.09%，TPlywood 成为 78.09% 控股子公司。
actions.text_en: The Company subscribed for an additional 14,750,000 ordinary shares (10.77% equity interest) in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. at RM1.00 per share, raising its stake to 78.09% and making TPlywood a 78.09%-owned subsidiary.

actions.title: INDEPENDENT ADVICE CIRCULAR IN RELATION TO THE UNCONDITIONAL MANDATORY TAKE-OVER OFFER BY QUATTRINI HOLDINGS SDN. BHD. ("OFFEROR") THROUGH R
actions.text: Quattrini Holdings Sdn. Bhd. 通过 RHB Investment Bank Berhad 提出无条件强制全面收购要约。
actions.text_en: Quattrini Holdings Sdn. Bhd. through RHB Investment Bank Berhad made an unconditional mandatory take-over offer to acquire all remaining ordinary shares in the Company not already owned by the offeror at a cash offer price of RM0.90 per share.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 公司通过认购 Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. 额外 10.77% 股权，将持股比例提升至 78.09%，后者成为控股子公司，集团业务扩展至综合木材活动。
model_changes.text_en: The Company increased its equity interest in Timberwell Plywood Sdn. Bhd. by an additional 10.77% to 78.09%, making it a majority-owned subsidiary and extending the Group's operations into integrated timber activities.
